name: Weedrug

regeneration.reason: The source character was too small relative to the environment.

reviewNotes: Regenerated painting with a large central character following Oniros/Voider/Eclyps. Official form anatomy and colors visually reviewed. Face bounds include forehead and muzzle; peripheral anatomy may extend under UI. Runtime remains responsible for the measured interface opening. No CSS enlargement above source size is required. UI validation is recorded separately.

framingReview.notes: Three equal heads: center head fits x .31-.55 but side heads reach x .095 and .80. Full all-head face box requires recompose; if the center head is accepted as the figure focus, keep main-face bounds separately.
